answer.reason: Beyond the summary's relation and command, the verses state that Pagiel brought his offering as prince of Asher on the eleventh day of the dedication of the altar.

clauses.english: offered his tribe's offering on the eleventh day of the altar's dedication
clauses.quote: On the eleventh day Pagiel the son of Ocran, prince of the children of Asher, offered:

doubts: Verses 1:13, 2:27 and 10:26 only name him as head or captain of Asher, which the summary already says, so they are not used.
